scorecard.rationale: One combined fall-or-dizziness event was reported in each original Alzheimer arm. Parkinson studies of formulated curcumin report aggregate motor outcomes or safety without separate fall rates. The stopped multi-supplement arm provides no curcumin-specific contrast. Two independent dietary curcumin studies from different Huntington models report opposite rotarod effects. The Parkinson rodent synthesis favored longer time on the rotarod with marked heterogeneity. These experiments measure time on a task. The clinical effect of ground turmeric on Parkinson fall frequency remains unresolved.
